newsitem.title: USA: Dow higher at midday, NYSE curb set.
newsitem.headline: Dow higher at midday, NYSE curb set.

text.p: Rallies in a handful of issues and a steady bond market took the Dow industrials higher at midday, triggering the NYSE's curbs on index arbitrage trades at 1213 EDT/1613 GMT.
The Dow was up 57 points at 6717, erasing Monday's losses, while market breadth was almost even keel. The Nasdaq Composite Index, heavily weighted with high techs, was down six points at 1198.
U.S. Treasuries perked up, with the long bond up 5/32 to yield 7.08 percent.
